365 * A steering group defines a group of apIndex's which can have steering done

367 * To remove a group configuration call with NULL as ap_cfgs, and length as 0.
368 * @param[in] steeringGroupIndex Wifi Steering Group index
369 * @param[in] ap_cfgs Array of AP Configurations.
370 * @param[in] length The number of AP Configurations in the array. Cannot be above 3.
371 *
372 * @return BML_RET_OK on success.
373 *
374 * @warning All apIndex's provided within a group must have the same SSID,
375 * encryption, and passphrase configured for steering to function properly.
376 *
